profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
With a technical and creative background I often find myself marvelling in the beauty of an elegant line of code or the magic of a complicated computing problem solved with a simple solution. It's with this perspective that I enjoy crafting solutions that provide an endless supply of inspiration while also simply getting the job done.

Specialities: Micro Services, Scaling, Performance, Systems Integration, Self Directed

GitHub: https://github.com/deezone

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am focused on the engineering and development of a micro-service solution for communications (email and SMS) with 5+ million users from around the world.  

Services I have developed use:
- PHP, node.js/express and Go 
- All PHP applications use an Object Orientated structure based on many popular patterns
- Unit test coverage using PHPUnit and Mocha (Node.js)
- Monitoring using StatHat and Slack
- RabbitMQ cluster as message bus
- MongoDB for persistent storage / Redis for caching
- Daemon processes to respond to requests (messages) in real time
- Scheduled (Jenkins) processes to provide mass messaging
- RESTful communication with services, internal and external:
      - Custom Node/Express based APIs for interfacing with Mongo and Redis databases.
      - Mobile Commons, mGage (SMS) and MailChimp (email)
- Interface with CMS (Drupal) for transactional messaging and image processing

Systems based on micro-services I have developed:

- Weekly Digest: Generation of a weekly custom email messages based on a member's activity.  A batch job using parallel and concurrency computing processes 5+ million user records to generate sending 600,000+ custom email messages in less than an hour.
- User Import: New user data in CSV file format is sent as file attachments to a Gmail account from an external source. Using IMAP, the attached file is ingested to create a message for distribution to various services - testing for and logging of existing accounts, welcome messaging and account creation in several persistent stores.
- Transactional Messaging: Decoupling of a monolithic content management system (Drupal) messaging needs to provide a micro-service solution. Creation of custom module to send requests to RabbitMQ message bus rather than block trying to communicate with messaging services directly.
- Internationalization: 
  - messaging in appropreate user language
  - use of different SMS services based on location
  - assignment to specific email lists for broadcasting
